intent: Restore effective full-history secret scanning with default rules and exact, reviewed historical false-positive dispositions; prove a planted finding makes CI fail.

reasons.evidence: The owned diff changes the hosted Gitleaks workflow and its security gate.
The completed batch pushes dev and observes hosted CI.

invariants: Default Gitleaks rules remain active; no broad tests path exclusion or rule disablement hides a new candidate.
Only the ten individually reviewed historical findings may be ignored, by exact fingerprint and with their redacted dispositions on record.
A disposable-history planted secret makes the same configured scanner exit nonzero without exposing a secret in logs.
Unresolved expired alerts and scanner-versus-Git patch-count differences remain explicitly unresolved.
rollback: Revert the workflow, config, exact-fingerprint ignore list and oracle together only if a replacement strict scan continues to catch the planted finding; retain the redacted history evidence.
verify_line: A disposable-history planted secret makes the configured Gitleaks job exit nonzero; strict redacted scans record scanner version, ref coverage and every historical candidate, and hosted push plus PR scan jobs pass after remediation.
oracle_provenance: Red-first commit fc2d2bd8 failed all three tests in tests/unit/t0180-secret-scan-config.test.ts before implementation. Independent R2 reviewer Pauli found scanner-order and Git-traversal gaps; a different author added the separate tests/unit/t0180-workflow-order-amendment.test.ts, red at four of four in d8f8dc68, SHA-256 2C7CA183E200BB57915264AF8118A0A8D987277F4D5B93C03335CCBFC38507FD. The original three-test file and names remain unchanged. The scanner's disposable-repository canary supplies a behavioural check.
approval: The operator approved the complete Phase 2 plan on 2026-09-28 and authorised prerelease T-0180–T-0187; Q-011 still gates structural work on the operator's rc.1 and v1.0.0 release.
review: Independent R2 reviewer Pauli verified the ten exact fingerprints and no broad path exclusion, and found the initial canary-before-scanner ordering, explicit Git log option and ambient checkout credentials. The workflow now runs both scanner steps before the canary, retains default traversal, and uses a read-only token without persisted checkout credentials. Hosted results remain pending.
